text:
kevin: Quick sync — Acme Bank pilot. They're ready to start a 2-week POC. Main asks: streaming SDK with function-calls, structured JSON output, short-lived creds behind customer proxy, and a ballpark reserved vs hosted pricing for ~50 QPS. Also they flagged SOC2/KMS question from legal. timeline: want everything testable in 10 business days.

jamie: I can own the SDK + handshake docs. Can you drop the exact auth pattern they want (proxy vs direct)?

kevin: They prefer a proxy inside their DMZ (SSE termination + auth bridge). Short-lived creds from our side is fine. They asked about IP allowlist + SSO for dashboard too.

maria: Pricing: for 50 QPS sustained we should propose two options: Hosted with autoscale estimate, and Dedicated reserved baseline with burst. I'll pull rough numbers but need workload shape (avg tokens per request, token ceiling).

kevin: Avg request ~120 tokens in, expect 200 tokens out. Peak sessions are 60 concurrent streams but average is 30.

devon: Quick note on handshake/creds: our recommended pattern is ephemeral token exchange via the bridge. Sample request flow: 
```http
POST https://bridge.acme.internal/handshake
Authorization: Bearer <client-cert>
{
  "client_id": "acme-poc",
  "features": ["streaming", "func_call", "struct_output"]
}
```
Bridge calls our token service to mint a short-lived SDK token. Tokens expire in 10m by default and we support rotation. For SSE we recommend `keepalive: 55s` and client reauth before expiry.

jamie: For structured output, use `content_type: application/json-llm` and the SDK will emit `struct_payload` events. Tool/function-calls work over the same stream — include `tool_schema` at handshake time.

kevin: Legal asked: can we guarantee no keys are stored in plaintext and that KMS can be customer-managed?

maria: Yes — for Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed KMS (HSM/KMS integration). For Hosted, we offer BYOK for enterprise plans but will need an EDR/contract clause. I'll flag for Legal.

devon: Small gotcha for proxy setups: if the proxy mutates `Content-Length` or buffers entire stream, we lose real-time tokens. Confirm they can proxy as a pure TCP stream or support chunked transfer. If not, we can advise a sidecar approach.

kevin: I'll confirm their proxy constraints. Also need a short runbook for the SEs doing the handover with commands and logs to watch.

jamie: I'll prepare a 1-page handover with: handshake sample, token rotation steps, SSE keepalive, common errors and `curl` snippets. Will post by EOD. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll post pricing ranges and KMS/legal notes in a follow-up thread after I pull numbers.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: new runbook draft created by jamie at https://redwood.internal/docs/runbooks/acme-poc-handover (permission: sales-team).

kevin: Perfect — if we can get the proxy constraints and confirm tokens expiry policy we can lock timeline. Thanks everyone.
